<a2ui>
surface("items-surface")

// Initialize filter state
$/filterStatus = "all"

// Sample data
$/items = [
  {title: "Project Alpha", status: "inprogress", detail: "Development phase ongoing"},
  {title: "Project Beta", status: "success", detail: "Completed ahead of schedule"},
  {title: "Project Gamma", status: "warning", detail: "Minor delays expected"},
  {title: "Project Delta", status: "error", detail: "Blocked by external dependency"},
  {title: "Project Epsilon", status: "inprogress", detail: "Testing in progress"},
  {title: "Project Zeta", status: "success", detail: "Ready for production"},
  {title: "Project Eta", status: "warning", detail: "Requires stakeholder approval"},
  {title: "Project Theta", status: "neutral", detail: "Scheduled to start next week"}
]

// Filter tabs
filter_tabs = tab_group(
  target="filterStatus",
  options=[
    {value: "all", label: "All", selected: true},
    {value: "inprogress", label: "In Progress"},
    {value: "success", label: "Success"},
    {value: "warning", label: "Warning"},
    {value: "error", label: "Error"},
    {value: "neutral", label: "Neutral"}
  ],
  panels={
    all: "items-panel",
    inprogress: "items-panel",
    success: "items-panel",
    warning: "items-panel",
    error: "items-panel",
    neutral: "items-panel"
  }
)

// Item template with status pill
item_template = columns(
  cols=3,
  gap="1rem",
  items=[
    {blocks: [text_block($title)]},
    {blocks: [status_pill($status, $status)]},
    {blocks: [text_block($detail)]}
  ]
)

// Filtered items list
filtered_items = _template(
  $[$/items | filter(status == $/filterStatus || $/filterStatus == "all")],
  item_template
)

root = body(
  [
    heading("Items"),
    filter_tabs,
    filtered_items
  ]
)

</a2ui>
